question: 销售额高于品类平均销售额的品类有哪些？
sql:
SELECT p.category AS 品类, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE f.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20261031
GROUP BY p.category
HAVING SUM(f.order_amount) > (
    SELECT AVG(t.category_amount)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(f2.order_amount) AS category_amount
        FROM fact_order f2
        JOIN dim_product p2 ON f2.product_id = p2.product_id
        WHERE f2.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20261031
        GROUP BY p2.category
    ) t
)

SELECT p.brand, COUNT(o.order_id) AS `订单数`
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20261031
GROUP BY p.brand

question: 家用电器品类中销售额最高的前2个商品是哪些？
sql:
SELECT
  dim_product.product_id,
  dim_product.product_name,
  ROUND(SUM(fact_order.order_amount), 2) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_product ON fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id
WHERE dim_product.category = '家用电器'
  AND fact_order.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20261031
GROUP BY dim_product.product_id, dim_product.product_name
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
LIMIT 2

question: 服饰品类中销售额最高的前2个商品是哪些？
sql:
SELECT
  dim_product.product_id,
  dim_product.product_name,
  ROUND(SUM(fact_order.order_amount), 2) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_product ON fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id
JOIN dim_date ON fact_order.date_id = dim_date.date_id
WHERE dim_product.category = '服饰'
  AND (
    (dim_date.year = 2025 AND dim_date.month BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
    OR
    (dim_date.year = 2026 AND dim_date.month BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
  )
GROUP BY dim_product.product_id, dim_product.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(fact_order.order_amount) DESC
LIMIT 2

question: 订单数最多的会员等级是哪个？

FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_customer c ON fo.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE fo.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20261031

LIMIT 1

question: 销售额高于大区平均值的大区有哪些？
sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS `大区名称`,
  ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS `销售额`
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE ((d.year = 2025 AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 3) OR (d.year = 2026 AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 10))
GROUP BY r.region_name
HAVING SUM(f.order_amount) > (
  SELECT AVG(t.`大区销售额`)
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(f2.order_amount) AS `大区销售额`
    FROM fact_order f2
    JOIN dim_region r2 ON f2.region_id = r2.region_id
    JOIN dim_date d2 ON f2.date_id = d2.date_id
    WHERE ((d2.year = 2025 AND d2.month BETWEEN 1 AND 3) OR (d2.year = 2026 AND d2.month BETWEEN 1 AND 10))
    GROUP BY r2.region_name
  ) t
)
